verdict.rationale: Anytype's own first-party Agents Skill says an AI agent can run scripts against your Anytype data to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks. That is backed by a local API able to query and update objects and a headless CLI for scripting. However, bulk work is done by agent-written scripts iterating over the API rather than a documented native batch capability, and the claim rests on a single doc sentence. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk endpoints or native multi-item operations, details on scale or limits of bulk edits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
